svg.title: One city. Four ways to read it.
svg.desc: A lamplit municipal survey desk overlooks a city hall and water tower. A leather register, floating-report radar, brass compass, charter seal, and parchment city atlas recur throughout the article. A magenta traveler follows a modeled route; it does not create facts.

g.text: CIVIC EVIDENCE LAB / A CITY READ FOUR WAYS
One city. Four ways to read it.
The public record. The listening signal. The governed atlas. The connected journey.
CONCEPTUAL MUNICIPAL SCENE / NOT PRODUCT UI
